SELECT (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS bps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '贵州茅台' AND f.report_date = '2025-03-31';

SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.high_price) - MIN(t.low_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility_ratio FROM finance_tax.stocks s INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.stock_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY pb DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses) AS average_taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025;

SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 AS tax_saved FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '腾讯控股' AND r.tax_year = 2024;

SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) * 100 AS actual_tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国中车' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

SELECT (SELECT (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' LIMIT 1) - (SELECT AVG((f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND c.industry_code = (SELECT c2.industry_code FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id WHERE s2.stock_name = '中国石化' LIMIT 1)) AS diff_pct

SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON c.company_id = r.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.non_taxable_income / r.revenue > 0.5;

SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(CASE WHEN t.is_private = TRUE THEN t.tax_amount END) AS private_avg_tax, AVG(CASE WHEN t.registration_type_code = '111' THEN t.tax_amount END) AS soe_avg_tax FROM ( SELECT r.company_id, c.industry_code, c.is_private, c.registration_type_code, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE OR c.is_tech_advanced_service = TRUE THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END AS tax_amount FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (c.is_private = TRUE OR c.registration_type_code = '111') ) t JOIN common.dict_industry i ON t.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY i.industry_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (STDDEV_SAMP((t.close_price - t.open_price) / NULLIF(t.open_price, 0)) * SQRT(250) * 100) AS annualized_volatility_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.stock_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dividend_yield FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND s.current_price IS NOT NULL AND (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 > (SELECT AVG((f2.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s2.current_price * 100) FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f2 ON s2.company_id = f2.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id WHERE f2.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND s2.current_price IS NOT NULL AND c2.industry_code = c.industry_code);
